adjudication.rationale: Verified: in lib/topic_retriever.rb#perform_retrieve, when SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled? is true it directly runs `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` inline (rather than enqueueing), then only afterwards checks whether a TopicEmbed now exists. Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed parses the entire feed and iterates `rss.items.each` importing each item, so a single embed retrieval path can synchronously trigger a full feed fetch/parse/import, which is an architecture/performance separation-of-concerns issue rather than a strict correctness bug.
